units: Sifré Num. 23 (ref. to Num. VI, 3) י׳ זה מזוג וכ׳ yayin means mixed wine, shekhar unmixed.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:1">Ab. Zar. V, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>יֵין נסך</he>, v. <cite ref="N00948"><he>נֶסֶךְ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 4b">Ḥull. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>סתם יֵינָן</he>, v. <cite ref="O01707"><he>סְתָם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 4b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>יינן של נכרים</he> wine prepared or handled by gentiles; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>יֵינוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:1">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:1">V</cite>), 1 sq.
